---
title: 'Chapter 4 — Data'
format: html
---

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, arrow, here)

data <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_quarterly.parquet"))
```

## Table 1, Panel A

```{r}
switches <- data |>
  arrange(MunicipalityCode, date) |>
  group_by(MunicipalityCode) |>
  mutate(change = treatment - lag(treatment)) |>
  summarise(
    ever_treated = max(ever_treated),
    activations  = sum(change == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    exits        = sum(change == -1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

switches |>
  summarise(
    municipalities      = n(),
    n_ever_treated      = sum(ever_treated == 1),
    n_never_treated     = sum(ever_treated == 0),
    n_switch_off        = sum(exits >= 1),
    n_switch_off_twice  = sum(exits == 2),
    n_activation_events = sum(activations),
    n_exit_events       = sum(exits)
  )

data |>
  summarise(
    observations  = n(),
    treated       = sum(treatment),
    treated_share = mean(treatment)
  )
```

## Table 1, Panel B

```{r}
data |>
  filter(date >= as.Date("2022-01-01")) |>
  group_by(ever_treated) |>
  summarise(
    mean_registrations = mean(n_installations_per_1000),
    sd_registrations   = sd(n_installations_per_1000)
  )

data |>
  distinct(MunicipalityCode, ever_treated, population, income_per_capita_eur) |>
  group_by(ever_treated) |>
  summarise(
    mean_population   = mean(population / 1000),
    sd_population     = sd(population / 1000),
    median_population = median(population / 1000),
    mean_income       = mean(income_per_capita_eur),
    sd_income         = sd(income_per_capita_eur)
  )
```

## Section 4.1: registrations before and after 2022

```{r}
data |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarise(mean_registrations = mean(n_installations_per_1000)) |>
  group_by(period = if_else(date < as.Date("2022-01-01"), "2019-2021", "2022-2026")) |>
  summarise(
    max_quarterly_mean = max(mean_registrations),
    mean               = mean(mean_registrations)
  )
```

## Section 5.1: distinct first-switch dates

```{r}
data |>
  filter(treatment == 1) |>
  group_by(MunicipalityCode) |>
  summarise(first_switch = min(date)) |>
  summarise(
    switchers            = n(),
    distinct_first_dates = n_distinct(first_switch)
  )
```
